resources.string: Back up settings, recipes and export records, without photos, caches or logs.

Contains %1$d settings, %2$d recipes and %3$d export records.

Matching settings will be replaced, including photo-deletion preferences. Recipes and records are merged without deleting existing data; conflicting recipe names are renamed.

Photos are not included. Restored records cannot open photos or restart exports. Import?
Backup saved. Keep it somewhere accessible after uninstalling. The file is not encrypted; store it securely.
Settings restored; %1$d recipes and %2$d records added. Photos are not included. Duplicates were skipped.
Could not process the backup. Check the file, space and access permissions. Upgrade the app for newer backup versions. Do not use a partially exported file.
Import did not fully complete. Saved changes remain; existing recipes and records were not deleted. Check free space and retry; duplicates will be skipped.
